apropos.title: Cultivating Excellence in the Heart of the Sahel.
apropos.description: OPE Agadez is a bold initiative designed to uncover and propel young Nigerian talents. We believe that innovation springs from the union of our rich cultural heritage and tomorrow's technologies.
apropos.pilier_1_desc: Access to intensive training programs designed to address both current and upcoming technological challenges.
apropos.pilier_2_desc: We transform raw ideas into tangible solutions. By providing the tools, mentorship, and ecosystem required, we catalyze the creation of startups with strong social and economic impact.
apropos.pilier_3_desc: Connecting young talents with experienced mentors and industry leaders to forge sustainable collaborations.
apropos.inspiration_quote: The desert is not a limitation, it is a springboard for the mind.
apropos.timeline_subtitle: Discover the milestones that shaped the history and impact of OPE Agadez since its inception.

categories_page.subtitle: A structured program built upon three fundamental pillars to address Niger's strategic needs.
categories_page.steam_desc: Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, and Mathematics. The incubator for cutting-edge technology.
categories_page.lp_desc: Entrepreneurship rooted in local resources: agro-business, resilient livestock, and artisanal excellence.
categories_page.mcc_desc: Civic engagement, public cleanliness, peace, and solidarity directly serving our communities.

sponsors_page.title: Our Partners & Sponsors
sponsors_page.subtitle: Their steadfast support is the essential driving force behind technological and educational excellence in Agadez. Together, we build the future of the Sahel.
sponsors_page.cta_desc: Associate your company's brand with a major social and technological impact initiative in Niger. Together, let's propel Agadez youth toward digital and entrepreneurial excellence.

form.title: CNCEIZ Online Application
form.subtitle: Complete this application form to apply for one of the 3 national Houses.
form.step1_desc: Select the main domain for your application.
form.step2_desc: Please provide accurate personal civil status details.
form.step4_desc: Detail your accomplishments or vision for the House
form.step4_status_label: What is the current status of your project? *
form.step4_project_label: Describe your project, idea or motivation *
form.step4_placeholder_steam: Describe the scientific or technological problem you want to solve, the tools you plan to use (code, mechanics, electronics) and your goals...
form.step4_placeholder_lp: Describe your local project: type of farming/livestock/craft, economic impact, needs and development vision...
form.step4_placeholder_mcc: Describe the civic action you have taken or plan to take: community impact, civic mobilization, message of peace and solidarity...
form.step4_moyenne_label: Most recent grade or academic result
form.step4_recommandant_label: Contact of a recommending teacher or mentor (Name & Phone)
form.step4_citoyen_recommandant: Contact of someone who can vouch for your civic engagement
form.step5_desc: Tell us what motivates you to join the Agadez 2026 national camp.
form.step5_motivation_label: Why do you want to participate in CNCEIZ? What do you hope to bring to your community after the camp? *
form.step5_motivation_placeholder: Tell us what drives you, what you want to learn alongside the 1000 talents, and how you will share your gains in your region...
form.step5_numerique_label: Do you have access to a smartphone or tablet during the camp? *
form.step5_num_shared_desc: A family member's or mentor's device
form.step6_desc: Accepted formats: PDF, JPG, PNG (Max 5 MB per file).
form.step6_piece_label: 2. School ID, National ID or Birth Certificate *
form.step6_autorisation_hint: Document signed by father, mother or legal guardian
form.step6_preuve_hint: Photo of prototype, certificate, article or video
form.step7_desc: Review the accuracy of your information before final submission.
form.step7_cert: I confirm that the information entered in this form is accurate and truthful.
form.step7_cert_desc: By checking this box, I pledge on my honor the truthfulness of all data provided and my full availability for the regional pre-camp and the national camp in Agadez in December 2026.
form.step7_cert_parent: I confirm as a parent / legal guardian that I have reviewed and approved this application.
form.step7_cert_parent_desc: By checking this box, the parent or legal guardian authorizes the minor candidate to participate in the program and certifies the accuracy of the information provided.
form.field_point_focal: Name of OPE focal point / supervisor who assisted the application (optional)
form.field_point_focal_placeholder: Ex: Mr. Amadou - Agadez focal point
form.field_bio_placeholder: Introduce yourself in a few lines: your interests, achievements and your dream for Niger...
form.submitted_text: Your application for the National Citizens' Camp of Agadez 2026 has been recorded.
form.submitted_next_desc: A confirmation has been sent to your email. The selection committee will review your file. You will be notified by SMS/Call for the pre-camp phase.
form.lp_desc: Agriculture, Livestock, Craftsmanship and Local Development
form.mcc_desc: Debates, Sanitation, Peace and Community Engagement
